label: Claude Haiku 5.5

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Hi, Luis, Jenna Cole from Brinewatch. Thanks for calling back. What prompted it?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Last spring a guest got sick after one of our corporate lunches. It turned out fine, but the client didn't renew and they were worth about $40,000 a year to us.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: I'm sorry, that's a hard way to lose an account. Where do you think the food got warm?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Probably in the van at the venue. We hold food in the vans while we set up, sometimes for a couple of hours, and nobody's really watching the temperature.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: How many vans do you run?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Five vans plus two walk-ins at our kitchen.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: And how do you log temperatures today?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Paper logs when people remember. Most of our event staff is seasonal, so anything we use has to be dead simple.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Is there anything coming up that makes this more urgent?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Holiday party season starts in the middle of November. That's half our year in six weeks, and I don't want to go into it blind.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Who else would be part of choosing something?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Kim, my operations manager. She runs the events so she'd have to like it, but it's my call in the end.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: And did you have a budget in mind?

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: That fits five vans and two walk-ins. Would it make sense to show Kim a demo since she'd be the one living with it?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: Yes, she's free next Monday morning.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Let's do Monday at 9. If Kim likes it, could we have it installed before the 1st of November so you're set for the season?

segments.speaker: BUY
segments.text: If she likes it, yes. Let's aim for that.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Great, I'll send the invite for Monday at 9. Thanks, Luis.
